acts.desc: Host Ira Glass explores a self-help cassette tape that promises to bring the listener peace about being single. The only problem is that it achieves this by having you envision your perfect romantic partner.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: Artist Julie Laffin talks about the inspiration for her "kissing projects." Jessica Yu's film Breathing Lessons is about Mark O'Brien, a man using an "iron lung." In this excerpt, Mark talks about the yearning he tries to quell through the use of sex surrogates. Poet Luis Rodriguez reads his poem "Waiting." Writer Dolores Wilbur tells a story of wanting love.
acts.credits: By Ira Glass, Luis Rodriguez, Doris Wilbur
acts.title: Yearning

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Audio artist Gregory Whitehead weaves a story of sexual discovery. And This American Life producer Nancy Updike makes an odd discovery about condom use... or the lack thereof.
acts.title: Sex

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Ira describes a wedding held in the dingy basement room of the City of Chicago's Marriage Court.
acts.title: A Wedding
